system.description: For making Attack Skill Checks with explosives. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. Goblin Explosives are so unstable that Critical Fails occur on a Natural 1-4. On Success, you safely use Goblin Explosive devices.

upgrades.description: Critical Fail occurs on a Natural 3 or less. You are able to determine the type, status, and raw materials of Goblin Explosives you handle.
Critical Fail occurs on a Natural 2 or less. You are able to craft explosives such as dynamite as if this were a crafting Skill, though you must have explosive raw materials and a Sapper's Table.
Critical Fail occurs on a Natural 1 as usual. You may create explosive raw materials out of non-volatile materials with the use of a Sapper's Table. Your crafting takes half the time.
